title: Bridging Worlds: A Performance and Feasibility Analysis of RISC-V Integration with EVM
abstract: An extensive experimental study aiming to bridge the gap between the RISC-V instruction set architecture and the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). This research investigates the technical feasibility of integrating RISC-V with the EVM to create a more efficient, secure, and scalable blockchain VM platform.

title: Cryptography and Zero Knowledge Proof Research Repository
abstract: A living research repository dedicated to implementing academic research papers, defining cryptographic primitives from scratch in Rust, and analyzing theoretical exploits in proof systems.
